comment: Relevance judgements for search ranking. Most query terms appear ONLY in prose (a doc comment or a markdown section) and never in a file name, path segment or symbol name — the case a name-only index cannot answer at all. Each topic lives in exactly one source file, so the judgements are unambiguous.

cases.query: bearer token for a verified principal
swap a near-expiry token without a new login
opaque keyset cursor instead of OFFSET
stale entries expire instead of pinning memory
read-through memoisation in front of the slow store
forward-only schema evolution resumed after a half-applied upgrade
prove the payload was not replayed
append-only record to back an investigation
